title: Lead Data Analyst
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


We are seeking a Lead \- Data Analyst for Reporting and Operations role in ABGD group, who can think strategically and interpret data. The role will be primarily responsible for managing intake process, perform A/B Test, Sales funnel analysis \& providing insight on data using Python.
About the Role


We are looking for a Lead Data Analyst to join our Gurgaon team. This role is for someone who is a strong data scientist first someone who can dig deep into data, build sound statistical/ML models, and translate ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable solutions. Exposure to Generative AI is a plus, but the core of this role is rigorous, hands\-on data science.


What You'll Do


Partner with senior stakeholders to understand problems, frame them as data science questions, and translate requirements into well\-scoped, actionable solutions


Conduct extensive exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover patterns, validate assumptions, and identify the right modeling approach


Build, validate, and maintain machine learning models end\-to\-end from problem framing to deployment and monitoring


Continuously optimize existing models for accuracy, robustness, and business impact


Write clean, efficient, production\-ready code in Python and SQL


Work with large\-scale data using AWS SageMaker, Redshift/Snowflake, and S3


Apply critical thinking to challenge assumptions, validate results, and ensure models solve the actual business problem, not just a technically interesting one


Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders


Must\-Have Skills


5–7 years of hands\-on experience in data science / applied ML


Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving ability, comfortable challenging requirements and getting to the real business question


Deep data understanding and strong command over exploratory data analysis


Proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy, scikit\-learn, etc.) and SQL


Experience with AWS SageMaker for model building, training, and deployment


Hands\-on experience with Redshift and/or Snowflake, and S3


Proven track record of taking models from concept to production and maintaining them over time


Strong ability to translate business problems into data science solutions and communicate results effectively


Good to Have


Exposure to Generative AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, fine\-tuning, etc.)


Note: This role is primarily a Data Science position. Strong core DS/ML fundamentals will be weighted more heavily than GenAI experience.


What We're Looking For


Someone who is genuinely curious about data, rigorous in their approach, and comfortable owning a problem from raw data to business impact, not just building models in isolation.

**Full\-Time/Part\-Time**


Full time**Timings**

title: Appian Business Analyst
description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking an experienced Appian Business Analyst with over 10 years of experience in the Mortgage Banking domain and a strong understanding of Appian Low\-Code Platform. The candidate will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams, driving digital transformation initiatives, process automation, and workflow optimization across mortgage operations.


##### **Responsibilities**


Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, operations teams, and technology teams to gather, analyze, and document business requirements.


Conduct workshops, interviews, and requirement elicitation sessions to identify business needs and process improvement opportunities.


Translate business requirements into detailed functional specifications, user stories, business process models, and acceptance criteria.


Facilitate communication between business users, Appian developers, architects, QA teams, and project managers.


Support change management and user adoption initiatives.


Work closely with Appian developers and architects to design workflow and automation solutions.


Create process models, business rules, user interface requirements, and integration specifications.


Participate in Appian application design discussions and solution reviews.


Review configurations and validate business functionality delivered by development teams.


10\. Support Agile delivery methodologies and release management processes.


##### **Skills**


Must have


1\) Good experience working on Appian BPM/Low\-Code platform projects.


Strong understanding of Appian process models, records, interfaces, business rules, reports, and workflows.


2\) Ability to translate business requirements into Appian solution designs and user stories.


3\) Experience working closely with Appian developers, architects, and QA teams.


4\) Strong understanding of Loan Origination, Mortgage Processing, Underwriting, Closing \& Funding, Mortgage Servicing, Loss Mitigation, Default Management, Foreclosure Processes


Nice to have


Prior experience with leading bank in Australia is preferred.
